actual.transport: HTTP Responses/SSE, custom unauthenticated loopback_fixture provider; NOT real builtin openai/ChatGPT/WS route

actual.scenario: First stream final text without completed, synthetic 200ms idle timeout, second stream normal completed with input10/output2. Actual stdout has reconnect error, so not exact P158 no-error reproduction.

observedAttemptAudit.scope: Observed parent-linked attempt diagnostics only; no provider response identity or global completeness claim.

semanticLimits: HTTP request logs link by traceId/spanId ancestry to try_run_sampling_request; handle_responses usage links to that same native parent. No timestamp or final-count inference.
First observed attempt has no completion usage, second has usage. This proves an observed diagnostic gap, not billed response count or missing token quantity.
API attempt field is 0 for both requests, so it is not globally unique. SSE logs have empty trace/span IDs; failure-to-request mapping cannot be asserted directly from those logs.
SSE event.kind=response.completed may carry error.message, so that kind alone does not prove success. Span status code0 means unset, not success.
No provider response_id was found in exported span attributes. rpc.request_id is not assumed to be provider request identity.
WS and real ChatGPT workspace routing are source-reviewed only. Same native sampling path is a source finding, not a successful real-route capture.
No inference about exact P158 root cause; final count is not response count.

captureCompleteness.sampling: All observed spans have sampled flags; SDK builder has no explicit sampler override in audited source. This run did not verify OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=always_on, so 100% capture is NOT established. Binary strings show support names but do not prove runtime behavior.
captureCompleteness.flush: Native batching/shutdown is best effort; shutdown ignores some return values. CLI exit0, receiver200 and quiet interval do not prove all spans exported. Current audit explicitly unsealed/flush-unverified.
captureCompleteness.missingTrace: Unknown. Neither absence of stdout error nor absence of a captured failed span establishes request completeness.
captureCompleteness.usageContract: Native usage fields remain provider-reported usage; actual invoice coverage remains unknown and is not a prerequisite for trusting valid reported records.

minimalNextPlan: Keep actual provider identity/auth/config/model/effort/transport unchanged; add process-local native OTLP exporters only, with prompt logging disabled and private bounded local storage. Do not introduce endpoint override or proxy for the paid path.

Before next paid admission, verify process-local always_on sampler is honored by installed CLI and guard preserves that env; receiver records batch hashes/drop counters/export errors. Establish explicit sealing/flush evidence or keep global request coverage unknown.

Use native attempt-parent associations as additional missing-usage diagnostics. WS-specific request/span association must be exercised without real provider calls first or labeled unverified; never silently substitute HTTP.
